## Delivery and safety

- [ ] The branch is based on current `main` and belongs to the cumulative parent scope.
- [ ] `src/sv_common/` is unchanged.
- [ ] No secret, credential, database URL, or production data is included.
- [ ] Frontend and backend promote from the same commit.
- [ ] Release notes were updated from the actual diff and evidence.
- [ ] Migrations, operational impact, rollback, risks, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] This pull request remains draft until release integration is complete.

## Approval boundaries

Review or child approval does not authorize merge, test deployment, production
tag creation, production deployment, server/DNS changes, GitHub environment
changes, or repository secret changes.
